summary: Iteration 32 verified: (1) local-disk storage replacing R2 — /api/scraper/status reports provider='local_disk', scraped image URL is under REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/uploads/scraper/... and returns HTTP 200 with a non-zero body. (2) Per-user Zyte quotas — GET /api/scraper/quota shape correct, cap=10000 override honored, remaining=cap-used; setting cap<=used triggers HTTP 429 with 'Zyte quota exceeded' on BOTH /jobs and /jobs/paginated; failed pre-flight does not increment usage. (3) Admin quota endpoints: GET /admin/quota returns {rows, global_cap}; POST /admin/quota/global-cap persists; POST /admin/quota/override sets/clears per-user cap; non-admin gets 403 on all three admin endpoints. (4) Paginated seed scraper: unknown provider→400, auto_publish without category→400, pages>50→422, pages<1→422; happy path returns {super_batch_id, pages_queued:2, child_batch_ids:[...2]} and /super-batches/{id} returns pages_done/pages_failed/pages_total/products_total/products_published. White-box seed templates for amazon_search/mercari_search/amazon_bestsellers match spec exactly. (5) Frontend: on /sell → Import from URL tab the five panels stack in required order (QuotaWidget y=370 → PaginatedSeedScrape y=476 → CategoryScrapeAtScale y=1091 → then ImportFromUrl & BulkImportFromUrls below). All seed testids present (seed-provider/pages/query/category-select/autopublish/hifi/submit). QuotaWidget renders 'Zyte credits — 2026-08' with 9886/10000, 114 used. /admin/quotas page renders with admin-quotas-page, admin-global-cap-input, admin-global-cap-save + per-user override row; sidebar link 'Zyte quotas' present next to 'Zyte scraper'. (6) Regression: fixed one stale assertion in test_scraper.py (storage provider now local_disk); all other iteration 28-31 tests (43 scraper tests) still pass.
critical_code_review_comments: services/quotas.py: assert_can_spend re-reads used+cap (2 DB round trips) when get_status already computed both; not a bug but 1 fewer trip is possible via a shared cache.

routers/scraper.py: /jobs/paginated creates N scraper_batches docs first, then calls enqueue_category per child. If enqueue fails midway, some pages will be permanently 'queued' with no worker; consider marking failed ones or wrapping the loop in a transaction.

routers/scraper.py: assert_can_spend is called BEFORE _valid_url check in /jobs/paginated; a bad provider would still not consume credits (we raise before assert_can_spend), but the ordering is inconsistent with /jobs where we validate URL first.

PaginatedSeedScrape.jsx: pollRef.current continues 3s polling if the user navigates away without unmount cleanup being reached; the cancelled flag helps but a stronger AbortController would be cleaner.

PaginatedSeedScrape.jsx: query parameter is URL-encoded only via spaces→'+' — special chars ('&', '#') will break the seed URL when the backend str.format substitutes. Consider urllib.parse.quote on the server side.
r2_storage.py: rehost_many is sequential (`for u in urls`) not concurrent — a listing with 8 images serially fetches 8 URLs; asyncio.gather would cut latency ~5-8x.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 new + 43/43 regression after 1 stale assertion updated)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Sell/Import panels + Admin Quotas page + sidebar link verified)
